what_happened: The ▷-elimination ▷(α∨β) ↔ α∨⊡β needed no new semantics: PlusPasting.lean already carries paste, paste_agreeUpTo/paste_agreeFrom, IsPurePast/IsPureFuture and truth_congr_agreeUpTo/agreeFrom, so the Lean half of the verdict was a ~300-line compiled-live probe on the first substantive attempt (two namespace typos only).

The dispatch's expected negative shape (a bisimulation separation on sinkFrame) cannot succeed: sinkFrame is a ℤ-time frame and ▷ is L⁺-definable on every ZTime frame via Gabbay separation + pasting. The verdict is class-split (positive at ZTime/RTime, open at Base/Dense because U/S is not separable over ℚ), which the dispatch's binary framing did not anticipate.

Probe 01 is sorry-free and compiled-live against the repository's own definitions, so the plan is a transcription plan rather than a proof-development plan; signatures were pinnable verbatim into a Lean Challenge Statements block with no re-derivation.

Planning surfaced three gate couplings the dispatch did not name: C9/C9D gate task-number and specs/ path citations at zero under FormalSystem/, docs/ and scripts/, so the module docstring cannot cite the research report by path and must stand on the GHR citation alone; C15's second assertion requires every theorem-index-rowed declaration to carry a 'Paper: - (reason)' line at its declaration site; and the probe's ofutP_of_pastDet carries an unused [F.IsRegular] binder that would be a NEW gated C16 unusedArguments finding, so the plan drops it (a strengthening, not a weakening). Also: adding a module changes generated inventory blocks in FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md, which must be regenerated via --emit-inventory rather than hand-edited.

Plan scoped six changed paths but a new .lean file under FormalSystem/ also forces regeneration of the generated library root FormalSystem.lean (check C33 asserts byte-equality with mk_all output). Seventh path added; regenerated with C33's own algorithm rather than hand-edited.

Probe 01 transcribed into the library module and compiled green on the first scoped build with zero errors; only adjustment needed was two 'show' -> 'change' tactic replacements to clear the linter.style.show warnings the probe never surfaced standalone.
